Draw ONLY this, alone on a plain pure white background.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones, black, olive and tan colours with a little steel, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No feet, legs, boots, socks or people inside or beside them, no text, letters, numbers, stencils or logos.
